name: Mineral and construction product sampling and testing operations
summary: The Mineral and Construction industries employ around one and a half million people and contribute around £17 billion to the UK economy. A Mineral and Construction Product Sampling and Testing Operator collects and samples mineral products, heavy construction products and/or final end use products to ensure they meet rigorous British and European standards (BSEN) and to ensure they meet customer specifications. Materials can include ready mixed concrete, cement, mortar, asphalt, road building and high speed rail products, precast and pre-stressed concrete. They work in a range of subsectors including mining, construction, quarrying, road building, waste and recycling operations. As product failure and poor quality can lead to end use failure, expert knowledge and attention to detail is essential.
overview: Collecting and sampling mineral and construction products to ensure they meet customer specifications.
